Replace the presence-only readiness query with constraints that encode every clause obligation: require the nonlinear case to provide evidence that bucklingResponse and plasticDeformation are reliably captured, retain acceptance evidence and the three margin quantities on their declared owners, and add a bounded formula/comparison constraint relating each permanent deformation operand to the relevantStructuralDimension. Keep ship-level margins on the ship and case-level quantities/evidence on the calculation case.

Add the required bounded formula-derived comparison for each nonlinear calculation case: validate permanent lateral and out-of-plane deformation against the relevant structural dimension as an explicit minor-relative-to relationship, with all operands on the same calculation case and correct comparison direction.
